description: Watch my video on my Youtube channel: @hear_it_use_it https://youtu.be/a1dN_qgANjo Recorded on the pebble beach at Whitehaven, UK. Gentle waves roll onto the shore, creating a soft mix of water wash and pebbles shifting with each small crash. A calm coastal ambience with natural texture from the stones, ideal for relaxation, sound design, or environmental backgrounds. Captured using a Zoom H1e in 32‑bit float, unprocessed except for level normalisation. No added effects — just the natural sound of the Cumbrian coastline. Location: Whitehaven, Cumbria, UK Conditions: Calm sea, light wave action, pebble shoreline
name: gentle-waves-on-pebble-beach-whitehaven
